clm_ee81c32f5321660e.claim_text: Manual audits across several animal-research domains continue to report deficits in randomisation, sample-size justification, control design, or related safeguards; however, the magnitude and direction of change vary by field and measurement method.

clm_6c7836280063b907.claim_text: A single-institution audit found sharing of all relevant data rising from 7% to 45% over a decade, whereas a field-wide meta-analysis still measures only ~2% actual public availability, and an oncology audit ~16% with under 1% FAIR-compliant.

clm_6d0196866698a57d.claim_text: The barriers are consistently identified as social and institutional rather than individual — reproducible practice depends on supportive policy, infrastructure, training, and recognised data-stewardship roles that mostly do not yet exist.

clm_3a81c58c85a6c751.claim_text: When the ICMJE made prospective registration a condition of publication in 2004, annual registrations rose from 3,294 to 23,384 within a decade — a fivefold jump relative to publication growth.

clm_bf08de80a0bf26dc.claim_text: The precedent is double-edged and therefore instructive: mandates that are tracked and attributed to identifiable actors move compliance, but the same mandates left unaudited decay into the same low reporting rates that plague preclinical work, and registry-publication discrepancies remain common.

clm_475ab2267385a171.claim_text: Selective and distorted reporting compounds at the analysis stage too: post-randomisation attrition can induce selection bias even under a null effect, pandemic-era meta-analyses showed 70.6% reporting-conduct discrepancies, and sex-difference claims are frequently asserted without a supporting statistical test even as policies push sex inclusion — while in some fields most animal studies still use male animals only.

clm_069ca2d64382d8ed.claim_text: Non-publication remains the root waste: laboratory-animal researchers themselves estimate only about half of animal experiments are ever published.

clm_877485ddc7e707b6.claim_text: Institutional animal-ethics committees approve almost everything that reaches them — a finding that recurs across empirical studies of committee decision-making and raises direct public-trust concerns.

clm_6bc95d8316b16505.claim_text: A "mission lapse" follows, in which oversight members assume that funding or prior review already vouched for scientific merit while no body actually takes responsibility for it.

clm_fec85973228eb1e5.claim_text: One proposal presumes review bodies can and should assess research rigor and expected benefit through a structured benefit-assessment instrument, while an analysis of US committees argues they structurally lack the expertise and mandate to judge scientific merit, so their approval carries no such warranty.

clm_133331020e02653f.claim_text: A scoping review catalogued 17 harm-benefit decision resources and concluded that deliberation among members should be favoured over numeric scoring, yet cross-national analysis finds the harm-benefit cornerstone of the EU Directive deficiently transposed and inconsistently implemented.

clm_79516f84b8801a77.claim_text: Institutional failures of animal care, when they surface, generate detailed corrective checklists that could be generalised but usually are not.

clm_f3e0e2ed9f6176e2.claim_text: First, enforcement over endorsement: guidelines must be gated at revision and checked, because passively published standards demonstrably do not move behaviour.

clm_3f90d23d148d2775.claim_text: Second, the target must be actual, FAIR-compliant availability and reuse, not declared availability, since the two differ by an order of magnitude and reform that clears only the lower bar changes nothing downstream.

clm_d10097cb67d497d2.claim_text: Third, the incentive and appraisal system must reward stewardship, following proposals to assess researchers on responsible practice and to make funders accountable for the waste they finance.

clm_327663af60a4d5cf.claim_text: Fourth, ethical review must be given the expertise and mandate to treat scientific quality — and the reuse of prior data that would avoid repeating an experiment — as part of the harm-benefit judgment rather than as someone else's problem.

clm_87ba8e51e86218da.claim_text: Roughly 85% of biomedical research is estimated to be avoidably wasted, only a fraction of preclinical landmark findings reproduce, and the diagnostic value of the preclinical enterprise has been estimated at a positive predictive value below one-half — every point of which is paid in animal lives.

clm_1d0ca90d585a6154.claim_text: Accountability for that waste has, over forty years, been progressively reassigned from the individual researcher to institutions, funders, journals, and reviewers.

clm_1601ec439f567b12.claim_text: The knowledge itself is compromised — the published animal record is filtered toward positive results, weakly protected against bias, and a poor, analysis-dependent predictor of human outcomes, with a direct six-intervention comparison showing benefit in animal models that vanished in patients and clinical success from first-in-human testing running at only single-digit-to-low-double-digit percentages.

clm_b53f77de51031c0c.claim_text: Whole classes of intervention illustrate the attrition, most starkly the hundreds of agents reported effective in animal models of Alzheimer's disease with essentially none translating.

clm_2a4ef9802efaaadf.claim_text: Even where the animal data are not in dispute, a defensible change in analysis can flip a model from mimicking human disease to failing to, so that translatability is decided by analytic choices as much as by biology.

clm_a508f6e452c6ed17.claim_text: And the welfare cost is paid regardless: a retrospective harm–benefit analysis judged fewer than 7% of preclinical studies ethically permissible on their realised balance of harm and benefit, with analgesia unreported in the overwhelming majority.

clm_f8a869f22be109d7.claim_text: Because Reduction was always a claim about information — use no more animals than the knowledge requires — a dataset that cannot be found, trusted, or reused is knowledge that must be regenerated, and the only way to regenerate knowledge from live tissue is to use more animals.

clm_c7727fa80e3c709d.claim_text: Unusable data are therefore not a downstream inconvenience but a driver of new animal use, and the loop tightens itself: the same reward structure that discourages complete reporting also produces the underpowered, unblinded studies whose results will not replicate, so the field runs experiments it cannot trust and then cannot reuse the animals' data to run better ones.

clm_fbe60c77571900ea.claim_text: The harm is doubled at the bench, because the animals bred to regenerate lost data are disproportionately animals killed without ever entering an analysis, and euthanising surplus animals is among the strongest reported stressors on the people who must do it.

clm_a1da3356f79187e6.claim_text: Each mechanism is a genuine lever; none is self-executing, and each inherits, in a new medium, the immature FAIR adoption that afflicts the animal data.

clm_3db203ac409ad955.claim_text: The stewardship failure recurs across FAIR data, virtual controls, and non-animal methods not because each field is separately deficient but because they answer to the same reward structure — one that pays for publication counts and journal prestige while pricing data stewardship at essentially zero and treating a researcher's data as a private asset with no release incentive.

clm_991256765f8440d9.claim_text: Even the reform instruments are contested at the root, the field split over whether quantitative metrics can be re-engineered into a force for good or are inherently corrupting and should be abandoned rather than repaired.

clm_8de1a686b561d0d0.claim_text: A mandatory, checked data-and-code policy pushed provision to nearly all manuscripts, confirming that the operative variable is verification rather than the requirement itself.

clm_d142fe84b94cfac3.claim_text: The levers are not scarce — hundreds of reporting guidelines already exist, and ARRIVE was even reorganised into an "Essential 10" after a decade of endorsement failed to lift reporting — so the binding constraint is enforcement, not the absence of a standard.

clm_641dd803e8235ded.claim_text: The debt is real, measurable, and self-reinforcing, and it is repayable — FAIR stewardship, data reuse and virtual control groups, and disciplined stewardship of the data that non-animal methods generate each break the loop, provided incentive and governance reform makes stewardship count.
